about: Which records a person remembers, and as what (design: docs/design/life-record.md). `events` are records made in play; a person named by one keeps it on their own list (src/core2/person-life.ts). `past` are the facts a person is built with and `history` the records of the simulated past; the reader joins all three into one life. `life` is the kind of event, `what` the event within it. `who` says which of the people a record names remember it: `named` (each of them), `not` with a fact (each but the one that fact names), or `kin-of-named` (the family of the person named, for a death). `facts` are the record's own fields kept as what the event changed. `notTold` names each record kind about a person that is told on no list, with the reason (a kind ending in * is a prefix); the test src/core2/life-kinds-told.test.ts fails on a kind that is in neither. `keeps` orders the kinds from the last a person lets go of to the first, for when a list is over its cap.
